text: PortCon 2026: AI Software Factory Summit | Nov 17-18, San Francisco About Speakers Agenda Venue Port.io Get Tickets Portcon 2026 The AI Software Factory Summit Nov 17-18 2026 | SHACK15, San Francisco Save Your Spot From prototype to production: How engineering leaders scale the AI Software Factory. Get Tickets In the 2-days event, you'll dig into technical sessions and workshops from people who’ve done it, connect with peers solving the same problems, rethink your SDLC, and leave with a playbook you’ll run on Monday, on how to ship a Scalable AI Software Factory Get Tickets Highlighted Speakers We've brought together industry leaders, customers, and technical experts, to show you what actually works: the infrastructure, operating models, patterns. See full agenda Travis Gosselin Principal Software Engineer, Developer Experience Travis is a Principal Software Engineer at GitHub focused on Developer Experience, helping developers build, collaborate, and deliver software at scale. He is passionate about simplifying complex systems, improving engineering practices, and enabling teams to move faster with clarity and confidence. A seasoned speaker, architect, and writer, he shares insights on emerging technologies and better developer workflows. Kelsey Hightower Minimalist Former Distinguished Engineer, Google Cloud, Author, Open Source contributor, Tech Advisor, and Investor. Zohar Einy CEO Zohar Einy is the CEO of Port, the agentic SDLC platform helping teams like GitHub, Visa, and PwC build their software factories. Zohar began his career in the IDF's 8200 unit as an engineer, where he and Port CTO Yonatan were involved in the creation of a large dev portal. He then joined TLV Partners and was a co-founder of Aporia (acquired), a machine learning observability company. Mark DeBeer Lead Software Engineer Mark DeBeer is a Lead Software Engineer at SPS Commerce, where he works on the Developer Productivity Engineering team. Over his 16 years at SPS Commerce, Mark's career has spanned a striking range — starting as a web and graphic designer before evolving into software development, giving him a rare blend of design sensibility and engineering depth. For the past year, Mark has been focused on integrating AI into the software development lifecycle at SPS Commerce, exploring how AI can meaningfully improve developer productivity and experience. He is a frequent external speaker on topics including Developer Portals and the AI-driven SDLC, sharing lessons learned from building these systems at scale. Mariane Bekker Director, Developer Relations Mariane Bekker is the Director of Developer Relations at 1Password, where she helps developers build secure agentic products. She is a software engineer and experienced technology leader who has led global engineering teams and developer programs. She is also the founder of Founders Bay, a community of more than 200k+ AI builders. Aaron Erickson Head of NemoClaw Engineering Aaron leads NemoClaw Engineering at NVIDIA. Previously Aaron co-founded Orgspace, a management operations platform. He has also held prior senior leadership roles at New Relic, Salesforce, and Thoughtworks. Michael Watson Platform Engineering - Developer Advocate AI/MCP Michael Watson is a Principal Developer Relations Engineer at Expedia Group, building the internal software factory for agentic development: remote agents, plugin marketplaces, and open-standards-first platforms that cut agent costs. Formerly Head of DevRel at Apollo GraphQL for nearly eight years, he founded the MCP Server Builder Series (3,000+ developers). Eagle Scout and Santa Clara MBA. Jan-Niklas Wortmann Solution Architect Jan-Niklas Wortmann is a Solution Architect at SpaceXSI, where he helps engineering organizations go from developers using AI in the editor to agents shipping production code. Before that he spent years in developer relations and open source. He spends most of his time on the unglamorous side of agentic engineering: guardrails, rollout, and figuring out whether any of it is working.
